CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_member_history_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin raise exception 'Membership evidence is append-only' using errcode='55000'; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_member_snapshot(p team_members)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('profileId',p.profile_id,'teamId',p.org_unit_id,
   'confirmedAt',p.confirmed_at,'effectiveFrom',p.effective_from,'effectiveTo',p.effective_to);
$function$
